cap: Ruling out early distant recurrence in stage III colon cancer — a simple 4-variable ML model with external validation
text: Ruling out early distant recurrence in stage three colon cancer: a simple four-variable machine learning model.

cap: 20–30% of stage III patients recur after curative surgery · early distant recurrence (≤18 mo) = aggressive biology
text: Despite curative surgery, twenty to thirty percent of stage three patients recur. Early distant recurrence within eighteen months signals aggressive tumor biology.

cap: AJCC staging leaves wide variation within substages · molecular tools are costly, not universally available
text: AJCC staging leaves wide variation within the same substage, while molecular tools are costly and not universally available.

cap: 4 routine pathology variables → XGBoost → rule-out probability · 331 derivation · 142 external
text: Our model uses four routine variables: AJCC substage, lymph node ratio, perineural invasion, and tumor differentiation. Trained on three hundred thirty-one patients, validated in an independent cohort of one hundred forty-two.

cap: Derivation: AUC 0.680 · sensitivity 77.4% · NPV 89.8% — vs AJCC 0.625
text: Internally, the model reached an AUC of zero point six eight, with seventy-seven percent sensitivity and around ninety percent negative predictive value, higher than AJCC alone.

cap: External: AUC 0.633 · NPV 90.8% · sensitivity 68.4% · DFS separation (HR 1.83)
text: External validation confirmed rule-out performance: AUC zero point six three, ninety point eight percent negative predictive value, and clear separation in disease-free survival between risk groups.

cap: SHAP: AJCC IIIC · lymph node ratio · perineural invasion drive risk
text: Explainability confirmed clinical face validity: stage three C, lymph node ratio, and perineural invasion drove risk.

cap: Free web calculator — 4 pathology inputs → probability + risk class, right after surgery
text: All inputs come from a standard pathology report, so the model works right after surgery. We built a free web calculator returning a probability and a risk classification.

cap: Retrospective design · limited external events — multicenter prospective validation next
text: Limitations include the retrospective design and limited external events. Multicenter prospective validation is next.

cap: 4 variables · ~90% NPV · a transparent, pathology-based rule-out tool
text: Four routine variables. A consistent negative predictive value of around ninety percent. A transparent, pathology-based tool to rule out early distant recurrence.
